_comment: KLD-130. Per card: en/de Wikipedia titles (de null = interlanguage link of the en article; most models have no article of their own, then the maker's or the vehicle type's) and the chosen Commons file ("" = no image, the card keeps the pictogram). Each file's licence was checked on its Commons page (CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC0 or public domain; no NC/ND, no conflicting licence). _check: what the file shows and caveats (not read by the tool). Not fetched yet; look at every photo after: python3 -I klunki/tool/fetch_card_media.py special

A1._check: dropped after the visual check: the fetched photo shows a person being interviewed, not the ladder truck. Was: File:Vorstellung Drehleiter Magirus M32L-AS Feuerwehr Köln-6433.jpg, CC BY-SA 4.0, Raimond Spekking.
